# David M. Auble — Indianapolis Solution Architect

> David Auble is an Indianapolis-based solution architect and web developer with 17+ years of experience in web development, disaster recovery, version control, and custom software builds. He has worked with organizations including IU Health, Eli Lilly, Salesforce, Anthem, Loyola, Marian, and Xavier.

This site is a personal portfolio and technical blog. The blog covers web development (JavaScript, React, Node), WordPress, Git and version control, enterprise architecture, and career growth for developers moving toward architecture roles. Content spans from 2010 to present, so check post dates for currency — older WordPress/PHP/browser posts may describe outdated practices.

## Pages

- [Home](https://davidauble.com/): Services offered (web development, disaster recovery, version control, custom development), background, and contact info.
- [Blog](https://davidauble.com/blog.html): Full chronological archive of articles.
- [Categories](https://davidauble.com/categories.html): Browse posts by category.
- [Tags](https://davidauble.com/tags.html): Browse posts by tag.
